correctness.rationale: Independently constructed the 16-vertex Hamming-one four-cube and all 742 nonempty independence faces; pivot matching yields 367 pairs, one critical 0-cell and seven critical 3-cells, with all 2816 Hasse-cover directions acyclic. This establishes Ind(Q4)≃∨7 S3 integrally and places reduced homology only in degree3. Independently enumerated every (t,p)∈F2^4⋊S4 (384 elements), applying oriented-simplex permutation signs to fixed independent faces to compute reduced Lefschetz traces; all 384 match the proposed character formula. Trace value distribution {7:1,5:4,3:6,1:188,-1:161,-3:24}; translation traces for t of weights 0–4 are (7,1,3,5,-1). Fourier inversion yields m0=3, m_|u|=3=1, other m=0. On translation-fixed block S4 trace is sign⊗Std3, and weight-three stabilizer S3 acts by sign; hence Q[G] decomposition into irreducible dimensions 3 and 4, with zero global invariants.
